sections.title: Reviewed foundations
sections.summary: Use semantic tokens and reviewed guidance as the shared starting point for every product surface.

principles.title: Start with semantic intent
principles.guidance: Choose tokens by the role they serve before choosing a visual treatment.
principles.rationale: Semantic intent keeps product overrides reviewable and preserves accessibility across themes.

sections.title: Accessible expression
sections.summary: Brand character reinforces meaning without becoming the only way users can understand or operate a surface.

principles.title: Make meaning survive styling changes
principles.guidance: Pair visual distinction, motion, and mascot expression with readable content and supported accessibility alternatives.
principles.rationale: A recognizable system remains useful when motion is reduced, colors vary, or imagery is unavailable.

capabilities.label: Semantic token guidance
capabilities.notes: Identity owns the reviewed DTCG token source, inheritance evidence, and generated platform projections.

capabilities.label: Reusable application components
capabilities.notes: Identity records component-facing constraints but does not define or distribute component implementations.

capabilities.label: Product layout implementation
capabilities.notes: Each product owns layout decisions while consuming approved identity constraints and bounded overrides.
